notes: The catalogue is rendered client-side and the page footer reserves all rights, so a claim cannot be read out of the HTML — it needs their API or a scrape. That is a decision for a human, not for this tool. Nothing is recorded against this source until a claim is supplied. Under `policy: pointer` this dataset may store at most one normalised value token per subject and the listing's URL; it may never store their prose, their selection, or their arrangement.
